div.l: He was nat pale / as a for pyned gost
A fat swan lovede he best / of any rost
His palfray was as browen / as any bery
AfreereA Frere ther was / a wantoıı̄un and a mery
A lymytour / a wol solempne man
In alle thordres foure / is non that kan
So mechil of dalyaıı̄uns / and fayre language
He hadde made wol many a mariage
Of yonge voomēn at his owne cost
Vn to his ordre / he was A noble post
And wel I loved / and famyliarye was he
With frankeleyns / overal in his contre
And with worthy womēn of the towıı̄un
For he hadde power / of confessyoıı̄un
AsAs he seyde hym self / more than a curat
For of his ordre / he was lycencyat
Wel swetely / herde he confessyoıı̄un
And plesaūnt was / his absolucyoıı̄un
He was an esy mān / to yeue penaıı̄unce
Ther he wiste / to have a good pytaıı̄unce
For vnto a pore ordre for / to yeue
Is signe that a man / is wel I shreve
For if he yeve / he durst make avaunt
He wiste that a man / so hard was repentaıı̄unt
For many a man / so hard is of herte
He may nat wepe / thow he sore smerte
And therfore / in stede of wepyng and pᵃrayerys
Men mote yeve sylver / to the pore Freres
His typett was ay farsed / ful of knyves
And pynes for to yeue / fayre wyves
And certeynly / he hadde a mery noote
Wel kowde he synge / and pleye at the roote
Of yeddynges / he bare vttyrly the prys
His necke white was / as the flour delys
